description: Service to service call graph derived by OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI) from the traffic it sees on the wire, without any application change.

panels.description: Every client to server edge OBI observed in the selected time range. Requests and errors are the deltas of traces_service_graph_request_total and traces_service_graph_request_failed_total; the mean latency is the server side histogram sum divided by its count.

targets.query:
let edgeTotal = (metric:string) {
    OTELMetrics
    | where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    | where MetricName == metric
    | extend Client = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client"])
    | extend Server = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server"])
    | extend ClientNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client_namespace"])
    | extend ServerNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server_namespace"])
    | extend ConnectionType = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["connection_type"])
    | extend Reporter = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.instance.id"])
    | extend Edge = strcat(ClientNamespace, "/", Client, " -> ", ServerNamespace, "/", Server)
    | extend SeriesKey = strcat(Reporter, "|", Edge, "|", ConnectionType)
    | summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by SeriesKey, Edge, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
    | order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
    | serialize
    | extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter)
    | where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
    | summarize Value = sum(Counter - PrevCounter) by Edge
};
let requests = edgeTotal("traces_service_graph_request_total") | project Edge, Requests = Value;
let failures = edgeTotal("traces_service_graph_request_failed_total") | project Edge, Errors = Value;
let latencySum = edgeTotal("traces_service_graph_request_server_sum") | project Edge, DurationSum = Value;
let latencyCount = edgeTotal("traces_service_graph_request_server_count") | project Edge, Samples = Value;
requests
| join kind=leftouter failures on Edge
| join kind=leftouter latencySum on Edge
| join kind=leftouter latencyCount on Edge
| extend Errors = coalesce(Errors, 0.0)
| extend ErrorRatio = iff(Requests > 0, Errors / Requests, real(null))
| extend MeanLatencySeconds = iff(coalesce(Samples, 0.0) > 0, DurationSum / Samples, real(null))
| project Edge, Requests, Errors, ErrorRatio, MeanLatencySeconds
| where Requests > 0
| order by Requests desc

panels.title: Service edges

panels.description: Rate of traces_service_graph_request_total. OBI counts an edge on the server side, or on the client side when the server itself is not instrumented.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName == "traces_service_graph_request_total"
| extend Client = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client"])
| extend Server = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server"])
| extend ClientNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client_namespace"])
| extend ServerNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server_namespace"])
| extend ConnectionType = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["connection_type"])
| extend Reporter = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.instance.id"])
| extend Edge = strcat(ClientNamespace, "/", Client, " -> ", ServerNamespace, "/", Server)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(Reporter, "|", Edge, "|", ConnectionType)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by SeriesKey, Edge, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter), PrevBucket = prev(Bucket)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| extend Seconds = todouble(datetime_diff('second', Bucket, PrevBucket))
| where Seconds > 0
| summarize RequestsPerSecond = sum((Counter - PrevCounter) / Seconds) by Timestamp = Bucket, Edge
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Error rate by edge

panels.description: Mean of traces_service_graph_request_server over each interval, measured by OBI at the server end of the edge.

targets.query:
OTELMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where MetricName in ("traces_service_graph_request_server_sum", "traces_service_graph_request_server_count")
| extend Client = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client"])
| extend Server = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server"])
| extend ClientNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["client_namespace"])
| extend ServerNamespace = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["server_namespace"])
| extend ConnectionType = tostring(parse_json(MetricAttributes)["connection_type"])
| extend Reporter = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.instance.id"])
| extend Edge = strcat(ClientNamespace, "/", Client, " -> ", ServerNamespace, "/", Server)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(Reporter, "|", Edge, "|", ConnectionType)
| extend SeriesKey = strcat(MetricName, "|", SeriesKey)
| summarize Counter = max(MetricValue) by MetricName, SeriesKey, Edge, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m)
| order by SeriesKey asc, Bucket asc
| serialize
| extend PrevKey = prev(SeriesKey), PrevCounter = prev(Counter)
| where PrevKey == SeriesKey and Counter >= PrevCounter
| extend Delta = Counter - PrevCounter
| summarize DurationSum = sumif(Delta, MetricName endswith "_sum"), Requests = sumif(Delta, MetricName endswith "_count") by Timestamp = Bucket, Edge
| where Requests > 0
| project Timestamp, Edge, MeanLatencySeconds = DurationSum / Requests
| order by Timestamp asc
